title: ServiceNow success: Why better discovery is the shortest path
summary: Improve ServiceNow discovery and CMDB accuracy. See how OpenText™ Universal Discovery and CMDB strengthens dependency mapping and automation.
body_markdown:
Most executives do not wake up worried about IT asset discovery tools. They worry about failed changes, business disruption, cybersecurity exposure, cloud waste, audit findings, poor operational visibility, and whether their AI-driven automation initiatives can be trusted. The uncomfortable truth is that many of those outcomes depend on the quality of the data in their CMDB.


Better ServiceNow outcomes start with better discovery data — every workflow ServiceNow runs, from change approvals to security prioritization to AI-driven automation, is only as trustworthy as the CMDB data behind it.


[THE ESSENTIALS: Before diving in, ensure your foundation is solid. Read: What is a CMDB?](https://opentext.com/what-is/cmdb)


[ServiceNow itself emphasizes that a healthy CMDB is essential to effective and continuous use of the product](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_CMDBHealth.html) and Those health indicators check for duplicate configuration items (CIs), required CI fields, audits, stale dependencies, orphan dependencies, and duplicate dependencies.[ServiceNow’s own Common Service Data Model (CSDM) documentation](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/zurich/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-landing-page.html) also states that the CSDM is the data model administrators should follow when configuring ServiceNow products and applications, and that proper CI and relationship structure helps maximize the value of ServiceNow AI Platform applications.


If ServiceNow is the workflow platform, then discovery data is the decision bedrock. If the bedrock is not accurate as described above, then the workflows, dashboards, automation reliability, risk decisions, and AI outputs built on top of it can inherit that weakness.


This is where[OpenText™ Universal Discovery and CMDB](https://www.opentext.com/products/universal-discovery-and-cmdb) complements ServiceNow.


## How does Universal Discovery and CMDB complement ServiceNow?


**Your ServiceNow investment may be constrained by what ServiceNow knows.**


OpenText gives ServiceNow better IT asset discovery data to work with.


Most ServiceNow conversations focus on workflow maturity: incident, change, asset, service catalog, automation, AI, and employee experience. But that misses the deeper issue. The value of those workflows depends on whether the platform understands the real operating environment.


**Key dependency examples:**


- A change request approval is only as good as the dependencies it understands.
- An incident workflow is only as good as the service relationships it can see.
- A cybersecurity prioritization process is only as good as the assets it knows exist.
- An AI recommendation is only as trustworthy as the operational model behind it.


Discovery and CMDB support troubleshooting, security, spending decisions, and change management by providing visibility into IT assets, dependencies, and configurations. The question is simple: Is the discovery data feeding ServiceNow good enough to support the decisions we now expect ServiceNow to automate?


## Why the CMDB should now be part of your AI stack?


Executives are pushing AI, automation, and digital operations initiatives across the enterprise. Analysts have noted that infrastructure and operations leaders are increasingly relying on AI-based analytics and augmented decision making. These improve operational resilience and responsiveness, address complexity, and process large amounts of data through automation. Analysts have also projected that by 2026, 30% of enterprises will automate more than half of their network activities, up from under 10% in 2023.


Automation depends on trusted context. If the CMDB does not accurately represent infrastructure, applications, cloud resources, network relationships, and service dependencies, then automation can become faster without becoming safer.


### Why is OpenText the best choice for ServiceNow?


This is what OpenText Universal Discovery and CMDB is built for: a unified operational model that consolidates physical infrastructure, virtual infrastructure, network devices, cloud services, applications, business services, and dependencies into one accurate source of truth. An AI strategy can fail even with a strong model if the operational context underneath it is incomplete.


## ServiceNow as the system of action, OpenText as the system of operational truth


You don’t have to choose between ServiceNow and OpenText. Let ServiceNow serve as the workflow and experience layer, while OpenText Universal Discovery strengthens the data and topology layer feeding it.


[OpenText Universal Discovery and CMDB is now a certified integration](https://blogs.opentext.com/opentext-cmdb-integration-for-servicenow-certified-app/) on the[ServiceNow Store](https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/1be6387897a983d41f08bbb8c253afa3) . It feeds accurate, continuously updated configuration data directly into the ServiceNow CMDB, without changing how your team works. That means richer CI coverage, deeper relationship mapping, and data that flows in both directions between the two platforms.


If ServiceNow is where work gets routed, approved, and measured, OpenText helps make sure that work is grounded in a more accurate model of reality.


## How does the cost of poor discovery reach beyond IT?


Many ServiceNow customers report that native discovery struggles to keep pace: inaccurate data, slow time to results, and rising costs, particularly for cloud-related discovery.


### Where does OpenText Universal Discovery and CMDB excel?


- Accurate discovery and dependency mapping
- Rapid deployment and ease of use
- Cost-efficient discovery at scale
- Deep endpoint discovery
- Broad CI visibility
- Advanced network discovery


The hidden cost of discovery is not the tool subscription. It is the cost of every decision made with an incomplete service context.


## What does this mean for your ServiceNow instance?


ServiceNow is not the problem. The problem is assuming that ServiceNow can produce trusted operational outcomes if the data feeding it is incomplete, stale, or missing dependency context. OpenText Universal Discovery and CMDB strengthens the operational truth underneath the workflows. That is how you make ServiceNow more valuable without asking the business to start over.
